content.summary: Exercise the repaired comparator and repeated investigation on both public development circulars, using three rounds and at most twelve calls per source. Proceed only after P7's full regression and frozen-output replay pass. Keep complete Boolean comparisons, unsupported encodings, prior failures and remaining uncertainty visible.
findings: Question: can the complete procedure generate competing readings, investigate more than one branch, run isolated reconstructions, and retain all stopping/uncertainty evidence? This is not a new legal-accuracy or algorithm-ranking study.
Comparator: the retained one-round P5 attempt-05 output and the unchanged engineering invariants. P7 must repair the observed missed link witness on those frozen readings before this live run.

Acceptance requires at least two actual rounds, three validated initial roles, accepted child refinement and reconstruction for each source, current Java checks, no unrepaired action failure and blocked legal release.

Three rounds and twelve calls are bounded resource hypotheses. A remaining frontier, model correlation, incompatible fact meanings and unresolved authorities are explicit results, never evidence of complete interpretation.

Failures remain counted under the authorized 100-call total ceiling. Same-source access problems trigger diagnosis; source corruption, exhausted allowance and absent human authority stop dependent work.
Stop after the required evidence is complete. The authorization to use up to 100 calls does not require spending all 100.
